Subject: SIG Questionnaire initiation — CareCore Health

Hi Jordan & Priya,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great to learn more about CareCore's use case and timelines. Per our call, attaching a copy of our SIG template and a short SOC 2 summary to kick off the vendor security questionnaire process.

Quick recap and proposed next steps:
- Redwood readiness: SOC 2 Type II (summary attached). We also support HIPAA-covered workloads; we can execute a BAA if needed.
- Action: please confirm whether you prefer us to complete your SIG/CAIQ or if you can accept our completed SIG template.
- Timeline: let us know your target date for completed responses (we typically turn around a completed SIG in 3-7 business days once scope is agreed).
- Clarifying questions for you (helps us prioritize):
  1) Will CareCore require a BAA for this engagement (will PHI be processed/stored)?
  2) Do you have specific data residency requirements (US-only / specific region)?
  3) Any additional questionnaire format we should plan for (custom vendor form / DocuSign / Portal)?

Attachments: CareCore_SIG_Template_v1.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

I'll coordinate internally to have Marissa (security) fill the responses once you confirm scope. If useful, happy to schedule a 30-minute follow-up with Marissa to walk through any technical questions.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire initiation — CareCore Health

Thanks Camila — got the attachments and the recap. A couple of clarifying items from our side before you start filling: 

1) SOC 2: can you confirm the report scope and date? We need Type II within the last 12 months. Is the full report available under NDA?
2) HIPAA / PHI: CareCore will classify some data as PHI. Do you have a standard BAA template or should we share ours? What controls do you have for PHI handling (access controls, logging, retention)?
3) Encryption & key management: is data encrypted at rest with customer segregated keys or platform-managed keys?
4) Subprocessors: can you provide a short list of subprocessors (cloud provider, monitoring, analytics)? We may need them documented for our procurement.
5) Format: we do have a vendor security questionnaire PDF (attached) — if you can fill your SIG template and also confirm the SOC 2 availability that should work for procurement.

Target timing: we need vendor responses within two weeks (by 2026-04-13) to stay on our procurement cadence.

Attaching: CareCore_Vendor_Info_Request.pdf

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Mills

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@carecorehealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@carecorehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire initiation — CareCore Health

Hi Jordan & Priya,

Thanks for the questions — happy to clarify. High-level responses below; we can walk through any items on a call if you'd like.

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering our inference platform and control environment; the most recent examination ended 2025-11-30. We can share the full report under NDA. The attached "redwood-soc2-summary.pdf" highlights scope and key controls.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads. We do have a standard BAA and can sign CareCore's BAA if that's preferred. For PHI handling we enforce role-based access controls, scoped encryption, audit logging, and regular access reviews. I'll provide a short control mapping to HIPAA rules on request.

3) Encryption & KMS: Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256). Key management is platform-managed by default; we also support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations for Dedicated/Private deployments.

4) Subprocessors: primary subprocessors are our cloud provider (AWS), monitoring/observability provider, and our analytics vendor. We maintain a subprocessors list and can provide it; if you need contract-level details we'll coordinate legal.

5) Format / turnaround: we can complete the SIG template you were sent. If you prefer us to fill your PDF, please confirm whether you need the answers returned in the PDF or as a completed spreadsheet. Typical turnaround for a filled SIG is 3-7 business days once scope (BAA / PHI / residency) is confirmed.

Next steps I suggest:
- Jordan/Priya confirm whether a BAA is required and any residency constraints.
- Camila to confirm procurement contact and desired delivery format.
- I will prepare initial SIG responses and SOC 2 under NDA; happy to review on a call week of 2026-04-05.

Happy to set up a 30-minute technical Q&A if useful — available most afternoons PST next week.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0234
